```python
deeper_script = """import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx')

# Order status breakdown
print("=== ORDER STATUS BREAKDOWN ===")
status_counts = df['Status'].value_counts()
for status, count in status_counts.items():
    pct = count / len(df) * 100
    print(f"  {status}: {count} ({pct:.1f}%)")

# Revenue by status
print("\\n=== REVENUE BY STATUS ===")
rev_by_status = df.groupby('Status')['Total Paid'].agg(['sum', 'mean', 'count'])
for status, row in rev_by_status.iterrows():
    print(f"  {status}: Total=${row['sum']:,.0f}, Avg=${row['mean']:,.2f}, Orders={int(row['count'])}")

# Customer breakdown
print("\\n=== CUSTOMER BREAKDOWN (by order count) ===")
cust_stats = df.groupby('Customer').agg(
    orders=('Order ID', 'count'),
    total_spent=('Total Paid', 'sum'),
    avg_order=('Total Paid', 'mean')
).sort_values('orders', ascending=False)
for cust, row in cust_stats.iterrows():
    print(f"  {cust}: {int(row['orders'])} orders, Total=${row['total_spent']:,.0f}, Avg=${row['avg_order']:,.2f}")

# Explode items to get individual product mentions
print("\\n=== MOST POPULAR ITEMS (by order appearances) ===")
items_exploded = df['Items'].str.split(', ').explode().str.strip()
item_counts = items_exploded.value_counts()
for item, count in item_counts.items():
    print(f"  {item}: appears in {count} orders")

# Confirmed-only stats
confirmed = df[df['Status'] == 'confirmed']
print(f"\\n=== CONFIRMED ORDERS SUMMARY ===")
print(f"  Count: {len(confirmed)}")
print(f"  Total Revenue: ${confirmed['Total Paid'].sum():,.0f}")
print(f"  Avg Order Value: ${confirmed['Total Paid'].mean():,.2f}")
print(f"  Median Order Value: ${confirmed['Total Paid'].median():,.2f}")

# Cancelled orders detail
cancelled = df[df['Status'] == 'cancelled']
print(f"\\n=== CANCELLED ORDERS ===")
for _, row in cancelled.iterrows():
    print(f"  {row['Order ID']} | {row['Customer']} | {row['Items']} | ${row['Total Paid']}")

# Date breakdown
print("\\n=== ORDERS BY DATE ===")
date_stats = df.groupby('Date').agg(
    orders=('Order ID', 'count'),
    revenue=('Total Paid', 'sum')
)
for date, row in date_stats.iterrows():
    print(f"  {date}: {int(row['orders'])} orders, ${row['revenue']:,.0f} revenue")

# Grand totals
print(f"\\n=== GRAND TOTALS ===")
print(f"  Total Orders: {len(df)}")
print(f"  Total Revenue (all): ${df['Total Paid'].sum():,.0f}")
print(f"  Total Revenue (confirmed only): ${confirmed['Total Paid'].sum():,.0f}")
print(f"  Cancelled Revenue: ${cancelled['Total Paid'].sum():,.0f}")
"""
await write_file("./deeper_analysis.py", deeper_script)
print("Script written.")

deeper_result = await run_command("python ./deeper_analysis.py")

```
